description: This file defines application-level processing functions for analyzing diff and commit data, including transforming raw data into analyzed results based on project types.

methods.name: ApplyApplicationMutations
methods.description: Transforms raw diff and commit data into analyzed forms based on project types.

methods.name: commitRowsToAnalyzed
methods.description: Converts commit rows into analyzed commit rows, assigning types based on project names.

methods.name: diffRowsToAnalyzed
methods.description: Converts diff rows into analyzed diff rows, assigning types based on project names.
